fit: First 16 CT and 16 nonCT in the original checked-findings panel. Train one conditional append from targeted-note errors via HCL raw and abstract memory and SkillOpt append. Require two distinct missed fit cases and a contrasting example. Up to one fit-only repair. No diagnostic labels.
gate: Next 16 CT and 16 nonCT excluding all 608 historical cases. Separate frozen 3B model labels applicability from each image and trigger/skip before predictions, with no captions, history, options, actions, or gold. Evaluate targeted vs generic and global candidate vs targeted. Require >=8 applicable checked views from >=4 cases, more rescued than lost covered views, no added contradictions, unsupported notes or exact option echoes on applicable views, and at least as many covered case-level positive changes as negative. No retry on gate. Stop if candidate invalid or gate fails.
confirmation: On pass only, next independent 64 CT and 64 nonCT. Compare targeted, global append and automatic image-only 7B routing on the same three images, history, choices and final reader. Fixed and global shadow the route call. Share deterministic calls across arms, three note generations each capped at 70 tokens and 35 words. Exact McNemar and 95% paired case-bootstrap interval; global vs routed secondary. Report route confusion vs blinded 3B labels, off-scope and by-stratum harm.
evaluation: Primary endpoint on confirmation is routed-minus-targeted correct cases. Reference coverage uses cleaned caption span and frozen 7B text judge. Unsupported findings audited independently by 3B from pixels, exact option echoes by text. Blinded model applicability and support scores are proxies. Reused fit rows excluded from all validation metrics.
